entities.name: Chimil
entities.description: The sun of Ixalan's Core and mother of the Deep Gods, worshiped by the Oltec, Komon Winaq and Sun Empire.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane whose Core holds Chimil.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: Chimil's eternal enemy, who tried to reassemble her prison sphere on his return.

entities.name: Coin Empire
entities.description: Invaders who caged Chimil with their invasion ships.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: People who worship Chimil and launched the final attack against the colonizers.

entities.name: Komon Winaq
entities.description: People present when Chimil was freed who became semi-divine, the first angels of Ixalan.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: Empire that worships the Threefold Sun, guided by an Apex Priest.

entities.name: The Threefold Sun
entities.description: Deity worshipped in three aspects, Kinjalli, Tilonalli and Ixalli, equivalent to Chimil.

entities.name: Kinjalli
entities.description: Aspect of the Threefold Sun who created humans from clay.

entities.name: Tilonalli
entities.description: Aspect of the Threefold Sun associated with fire and passion.

entities.name: Ixalli
entities.description: Aspect of the Threefold Sun that fosters growth.

entities.name: Gishath
entities.description: Dinosaur embodying all three aspects of the sun.

entities.name: Caztaca Huicintli
entities.description: Current Apex Priest of the Sun Empire, aunt and tutor of Apatzec Intli IV.

entities.name: Apatzec Intli IV
entities.description: Nephew and pupil of Caztaca Huicintli.

entities.name: Ojer Axonil
entities.description: One of the Deep Gods, child of Chimil.

events.summary: After the Coin Empire's invasion, Chimil was caged and freed only after 320 years of darkness when the Oltec attacked; she destroyed her prison.
events.quote: After an invasion by the Coin Empire , she was caged by their invasion ships

events.summary: Cosmium lashed out from Chimil, blasting away the colonizers and making the Komon the first angels of Ixalan.
Aclazotz returned and tried to reassemble Chimil's imprisoning sphere, briefly plunging the Core into night.
events.quote: the bat god attempted to reassemble Chimil's imprisoning sphere, briefly plunging the Core into nighttime.

relations.note: Chimil is the mother of the Deep Gods.
relations.quote: Chimil is considered the mother of the " Deep Gods ,"
aunt and chief tutor of Apatzec Intli IV

relations.note: Apex Priest steering the empire's faith.
relations.quote: The current Apex Priest is Caztaca Huicintli
